line: Skokie (Skokie) Bitch, I’m from the Southside, ain’t from Skokie
vault_lines: Bitch, I'm from the Southside, ain't from Skokie
meaning:
Skokie is a suburb near to the northern city limits of Chicago. Keef draws a contrast to the South Side neighborhoods in which he grew up, some 20 miles south.

The South Side is generally an underdeveloped and poor part of the city and is historically where the majority of the city’s Black residents reside. Skokie, on the other hand, can represent the pattern of “white flight” from the city into more secluded and wealthy suburban areas. However, growing up in the suburbs also means one may be seen as soft compared to someone, like Chief Keef, who has street cred from growing up in a rough area on the South Side.

line: On a hill with your bitch, just call us Jack and Jill (Call us Jack and Jill)
vault_lines: On a hill with your bitch, just call us Jack and Jill (Call us Jack and Jill)
meaning:
Ski is referencing the traditional English nursery rhyme “Jack and Jill,” written in the 18th century. Ski compares him being with someone else’s girl with Jack and Jill on the hill.

Jack and Jill went up the hill
To fetch a pail of water
Jack fell down and broke his crown
And Jill came tumbling after

The phrase “Jack and Jill” existed in England as far back as the 1590s and was used to indicate a boy and girl as a generic pair.

line: Niggas don’t be real like Fentanyl in a pill (Huh, huh, ayy)
vault_lines: Niggas don't be real like Fentanyl in a pill (Huh, huh, ayy)

Fentanyl is a highly addictive, synthetic opioid that is 80-100 times stronger than morphine.  Extremely potent and relatively cheap, it is often used as an additive by producers of illegal drugs, and has caused spikes in overdose deaths through its use in substances sold as Xanax, heroin, and other drugs.  Synthetic opioids are the most common drugs involved in overdose deaths in America.

Just as Fentanyl is sold as a dangerous stand-in for other drugs, Ski accuses his rivals of being inauthentic.
